metadata.title: Palo Alto Earnings Crushed Estimates. Now, the Stock Is Getting Crushed. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Palo Alto Stock Is Getting Crushed After a Huge Earnings Beat
Cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks reported strong fourth-quarter earnings results on Tuesday afternoon—but the results weren’t good enough for the high-flying stock.
